Fit a theory-defined strategy-informed IRT model

Source: R/022-advanced-models-v2.R
fit_theory_strategy_irt.Rd

Strategy prototypes are declared before estimation. Posterior strategy probabilities are computed from Gaussian feature-distance likelihoods and entered into a response model with person and item effects.

Usage

fit_theory_strategy_irt(
  x,
  spec,
  response = "score",
  participant = "participant_id",
  item = "item_id"
)

Arguments

x

An `eye_dataset` or model data frame.

spec

Theory strategy specification.

response

Response column.

participant

Participant column.

item

Item column.

Value

An `eye_theory_strategy_irt` object.
